Answer: F
Reason: Figure 1 demonstrates extensive pneumomediastinum (indicated by arrows outlining the mediastinal structures) and subcutaneous emphysema (radiolucent streaks in the soft tissues of the neck and chest wall), while Figure 4 shows complete resolution of these findings with normal lung fields and soft tissues. This rapid spontaneous resolution confirms the diagnosis of benign spontaneous pneumomediastinum, which is successfully managed conservatively without surgical intervention.
